receipt_and_invoice_specs.print_rules: Receipt must be printable via standard window.print() styling and downloadable as PDF/printable card view
receipt_and_invoice_specs.branding_header: PASTRY QUIN wordmark in classic serif, Atelier Address, Studio Phone, Tax/Receipt No, Order Date, Delivery/Pick-up Date
sections: Cake specifications (Tier count, flavor, filling, serving estimate, confirmed design thumbnail)
Financial breakdown (Base cake price, bespoke decoration fee, delivery/setup fee, total)
Payment ledger (Date, method, amount paid, transaction note, remaining balance)
Care instructions & terms (Room temp delivery, refrigeration protocols, non-refundable deposit terms)

empty_state_first_run.rule: System starts completely empty with zero demo data as requested by user.
empty_state_first_run.empty_state_action: High-craft empty states with inviting prompts: 'Create First Client', 'Commission New Cake Order', 'Configure Flavors & Sizes', or 'Load Studio Seed Data (Optional for testing)' so user can easily populate and test immediately.

order_detail_view.hero_split: Confirmed Final Cake Design (prominent visual card with lightbox zoom, dimensions, color swatches) vs Reference Inspo gallery
order_detail_view.urgency_badge: Days left pill: '3 days until delivery' (Urgent: Raspberry; Normal: Warm caramel; Today: Pulsing highlight)

calendar_system.event_pill: Boutique compact badge showing cake category dot, client name, and status

instructions_to_main_agent: Always render brand as exact case 'PASTRY QUIN'. Never change capitalization or spelling.
Strictly honor the user's choice: Clearly separate Wedding / Introduction cakes from Normal (small) cakes with distinct tabs, badges, and filtration.

Ensure Receipts support: 1) Modal view with luxury stationery styling, 2) Direct window.print() optimized CSS (@media print rules), and 3) Downloadable/HTML printable view with complete payment audit trail.

First run must start clean with empty database (no fake demo data baked into initial state), but provide an intuitive 'Load Demo Preview' button in the empty state or Settings so testing can be performed effortlessly.
Keep all files in React .js / .jsx (not .tsx) as the project uses JavaScript with Tailwind and Radix UI.

Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive and key data elements (e.g. data-testid='order-category-wedding', data-testid='new-order-btn', data-testid='receipt-print-btn', data-testid='payment-submit-btn').
Use Lucide icons sparingly and with elegant stroke weights (size 16-18px), never cartoonish cake icons.
Ensure contrast meets WCAG AA standards using the custom cocoa (#2B1B17) and muted earthen shades against vanilla cream (#FAF8F5).
